facts.business: Jayant Infratech Limited is a specialised railway infrastructure company engaged in the design, supply, erection, testing and commissioning of 25 KV, 50 Hz Single Phase Traction Overhead Equipment (OHE) and associated power supply infrastructure, along with railway maintenance, Power Supply Installation (PSI), P-Way works, signalling and telecommunication, private railway siding and allied electrical works.

segments.name: Power Supply Installation (PSI), P-Way, Signalling & Telecommunication, Private Siding & Allied Electrical Works

key_risks: Significant judgment in revenue recognition from diverse contractual arrangements (fixed monthly charges, activity-based billing, milestone-based payments, time-and-material) involving identification of performance obligations, measurement of stage of completion, customer acceptance, and appropriate accounting period recognition.
